main_text.p: tem habere.In tractatione atq; collocatione,prima pars exordium inftitutæ lauda-tionis occasionem & caufas continebit. Altera fententias & argumenta copleętetur,quæ in perfonarū adhibenda effe laudatione modò oftendimus. Quia etiam nihil omni ex parte perfectum: nec tam felix quifquâ,qui nô aliquâdo labatur & erret, aut maleuolos atq; calumniatores habeat: excufanda nonnunquam ac refutanda diligenter, quæ vituperari ab aliis poffe videntur. Poftrema pars conclufio abfoluetur, aut συγχαρεισία [?] gratulatione,fi ad fuperiorem fcribedum: aut παραίνεσει [?] adhortatione, fi cum paribus, vel etiam inferioribus agendum : aut ἀξιώσει [?], fi commendatione noftra impetrare aliquid a-liis volumus:aut deniq; præcifione & re-iectione. Nos exercitij gratia exemplum tale proponemus.

Perfonarum laudationis exemplum.I. Intellexi vehementer te mirari quid fit, quod cum aduerfas res, omnes alias infracto semper ere-ctoq; animo tulerim: nunc vnius amici tantopere obitum lugeam, vt confolationi apud me nullus relictus effe locus videatur.
II. Verū mirari,vti mea quidē fert opinio,definies: vbi doloris huius mei atq; luctus caufas cognoueris.
III.Etenim fi quifquâ omnium lucis huius dignus

page.notes: Greek words in the third and fourth paragraph lines (συγχαρεισία, παραίνεσει, ἀξιώσει) are uncertain and marked [?]. The word "collocatione" is joined from a line-end without a printed hyphen. "refutanda" is joined from a line-end; no hyphen is clearly printed. The marginal note "Perfonarum" appears at line level beside paragraph I. The catchword "vfura" is at the lower right. Possible printing error: "definies" in paragraph II may be "defines" (the scan reads "defines" with the second letter unclear); copied as printed with "definies" is uncertain, so the reading should be checked. Right edge of the page is cut off by the scan, so the final line may be incomplete.
